verdict.rationale: Modal Sandboxes is explicitly designed for programmatic, agent-driven provisioning of isolated code-execution environments with SDK/CLI control over creation, command execution, filesystem access, and teardown (modal-docs-1/2/8/13/15/18), and community usage (an agent JS runtime driving Sandboxes via gRPC) corroborates real autonomous end-to-end use (modal-comm-2). missing for 10: X, Y — no first-party worked example showing full create→execute→read-results→teardown loop in one narrative, and no independent benchmark/hands-on report validating full lifecycle reliability at scale.
